content: KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “I pahn wiahiong uhk pwe ke en rasehng Koht mwohn Parao, oh riomw Aaron pahn koasoiong duwehte omw soukohp.
Ke pahn ndaiong Aaron mehkoaros me I koasoanediong uhk, oh e ahpw pahn patohwanohng Parao en mweidala mehn Israel kan pwe re en mweselda sang Isip.
Ahpw I pahn kakeptakaila nan kapehden nanmwarkio, oh e sohte pahn rong uhk, mehnda ma I pahn wiahda manaman kamasepwehk kei nan Isip,
I pahn kalokehki mehn Isip kan kalokolok mwuledek, oh mwuri, I ahpw pahn kahluwa nei aramas akan sang nan sahpwo.
Mehn Isip kan eri pahn esehla me iei ngehi me KAUN-O, ni ei pahn pelian irail oh kahluwaieisang mehn Israel kan nan Isip.”
Moses oh Aaron eri kapwaiada dahme KAUN-O ketin mahsanih.
Moses sounpar 80, a Aaron sounpar 83, ni ahnsou me ira tuhwong Parao.
En Aaron eh Sokon
KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanihong Moses oh Aaron,
“Ma Parao pahn mahsanihong kumwa, ‘Kumwa kadehdehkihda pein kumwa ehu manamanen,’ eri, ke pahn ndaiong Aaron, ‘Ale omw sokonen oh kesehdiong mwohn Parao, oh e pahn wiahla sineik men.’”
Moses oh Aaron eri patohla rehn Parao oh wiahda soahng koaros me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ira. Aaron kesehdiong nanpwel eh sokono mwohn Parao oh sapwellime lapalap ako, e ahpw wiahla sineik men.
Parao eri malipepene sapwellime aramas loalokong kan oh sounakmanaman kan; re ahpw pil wiahda soahngohte sang ni ar akmanaman.
Re kesehdiong nanpwel ar sokon kan, sokon ko ahpw pil wiahla sineik. Ahpw en Aaron eh sokono kadallehla ar sokon ko koaros.
Eri soh, Parao me inenen keptakai; oh sohte men rong ira, duwen me KAUN-O ketin mahsanih.
Nta
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses, “Parao me inenen keptakai oh e sohte mweidohng aramas akan en kohkohla.
Eri, kohwei oh tuhwong Parao nimenseng, ni eh pahn ketilahng ni Pillap Nail. Awihedi ni keilen pillapo. Wa kohwei sokonen me wiahla sineik.

Ke ahpw patohwanohng Parao, ‘KAUN-O, Koht en mehn Ipru kan, ketin kederiehdo pwe I en patohwanohng komwi en mweidohng sapwellime aramas akan re en patopatohla, pwe re en patolahng kaudokiong nan sapwtehn. Eri, lel met komw sohte men karonge.
Eri, maing, KAUN-O mahsanih, me komw pahn mwahngihala ihs ih sang dahme e pahn ketin wia. Eri, komw mahsanih, pwe I pahn poakihki sokon wet pilen pillapet, a e pahn wiahla nta.
Mwahmw akan pahn mehla oh matala nan pillap wet, me kahrehda mehn Isip kan sohla pahn kak nimpil sang ie.”

KAUN-O ahpw pil mahsanihong Moses, “Ndaiong Aaron en ale eh sokono oh kapahwei pohn pihl koaros en Isip, pillap akan, dahu kan, oh leh kan. Pihl koaros pahn wiahla nta, oh nta pahn audehla wasa koaros nan sahpwo, pil iangahki nan pwoaren tuhke kan, oh nan pwoaren paip akan.”
Eri, Moses oh Aaron ahpw kapwaiada dahme KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ira. Aaron pwekada eh sokono oh poakihki pillapo; pilen pillapo ahpw wiahla nta mwohn Parao oh sapwellime lapalap ako.
Mwahmw akan ahpw mehla nan pillapo, oh pihlo inenen pwohsuwedla, ihme kahrehda mehn Isip kan sohla kak nimpil sang ie. Pihl koaros nan Isip wiahla nta.
Sounakmanaman en Isip ko pil wiahda soahngohte, sang ni ar akmanaman, me kahrehda Parao inenen keptakaila. E sohte mwahn karonge Moses oh Aaron, duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanih.
Parao eri ketin sapahllahng ni tehnpeseo, soh mwahn kupwurohki mehkotet.
Mehn Isip koaros ahpw weirada ni keilen pillapo pwoahr en pihl kei, pwehki ar sohla kak nim pilen pillapo.
Mwurin kalokolok wet, rahn isuh dou powe, a ehu kalokolok pil wiawi.
